python -c "
import semver

# Test edge cases
# 1. replace with no kwargs should return same version
r = semver.replace('1.2.3')
print('replace(\"1.2.3\") = %r' % r)
assert r == '1.2.3'

# 2. replace with invalid keys should be ignored
r = semver.replace('1.2.3', unknown_key='value')
print('replace(\"1.2.3\", unknown_key=\"value\") = %r' % r)

# 3. VersionInfo.replace with no kwargs
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
v2 = v.replace()
print('VersionInfo(1,2,3).replace() = %s' % v2)
assert v2 == semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)

# 4. Test type coercion  
r = semver.replace('1.2.3', major='2')
print('replace(\"1.2.3\", major=\"2\") = %r' % r)

print('All edge case tests passed!')
"
